abstract: In a review of our experience with seminoma 9 cases of bilateral primary testis germ cell tumors were encountered, including 2 simultaneous and 7 successive. Of the 9 cases 6 were bilateral seminomas and 7 were stage I, contributing to the good survival experience. Treatment policy is specified and discussed.
abstract_ja: セミノーマ症例の経験を振り返ると、両側性の精巣原発胚細胞腫瘍9例が認められ、同時性2例と異時性7例が含まれた。9例中6例は両側セミノーマで、7例は病期Iであり、良好な生存成績に寄与している。治療方針を明示し、考察した。
